family: Selected-file Blame and document-owned recent-history publication
demonstrated_source_defects: Initial and replacement successful document loads published recent-bookmark persistence failures as fatal model.error.
Initial onLoaded resolved self.model dynamically rather than retaining the loaded document's identity; replacements lacked an onLoaded persistence retry callback.
implementation: One exact-model, repository, literal-path, revision, access and archive publisher serves initial and replacement loads.
Persistence failures use the existing nonfatal recentHistoryError presentation; genuine document errors remain separate.
Reload retries persistence, clearing only the same owner's recorded save warning on success.
Replaced/retired callbacks refuse publication and cannot alter the current archive or warning.
Open preparation captures the replacement recent ID and verifies its original model remains current before adoption or failure publication.
Undecoded retained documents keep their actual decoding error and defer MRU registration until successful codec recovery; historical revisions remain excluded.
